outcomes: A service wraps a loader with the cache-aside call shape and runs it once per cold key, however many callers miss at the same time
A cached value stops being served once its TTL elapses or a caller evicts its key, in memory, on disk and through the layered storage
A disk cache survives a restart and keeps only the most recent build versions
An HTTP route publishes its Cache-Control policy and answers a matching conditional request with 304 and no body
nonGoals: Providing distributed cache coherence or a network cache backend
Bounding the number of in-memory entries or counting hits and misses
Matching glob patterns against individual disk keys, which the disk storage hashes

requirements.text: cache(name).fetch runs the loader on a miss and returns the stored value on a hit, without running the loader again. The stored key is the cache name, a colon and the key: a static string, the result of a key function over the fetch arguments, or the JSON of the arguments when no key is set. A synchronous loader is cached the same way.
Concurrent fetches of one cold key run the loader once, and every caller receives its value.

An entry stored with a positive TTL is not served once the TTL elapses, in memory and on disk, and the next fetch runs the loader again. An entry stored without a TTL carries no expiration and stays served.
evictCache deletes the keys that match its glob pattern and returns their count, clearCache deletes every key, and the next fetch of an evicted key runs the loader again.
InMemoryCacheStorage stores a copy of each value: mutating a value after set, or mutating a value that get returned, never changes what later readers receive.

DiskCacheStorage serves a value to a new instance that uses the same directory, reads a corrupted cache file as a miss, deletes exactly one entry for a pattern without wildcards, and clears its whole namespace for a pattern with a wildcard.

evictOldVersionsInDir keeps the five most recently modified build-version directories and removes the older ones. It removes nothing when the directory holds five or fewer, and it resolves without error when the directory does not exist.

LayeredCacheStorage refuses an empty layer list. It reads layers in order and returns the first hit, copies a hit from a slower layer into the faster layers with its remaining TTL, and writes every set to all layers.

CacheMiddleware sets the Cache-Control header built from its options: a raw cacheControl string wins over every shorthand, privateMaxAge wins over maxAge, and s-maxage and stale-while-revalidate are appended. When no option applies, the response carries no Cache-Control header.

With etag enabled, a request whose If-None-Match equals the response ETag receives a 304 that carries the ETag and no body, and a streamed body that the 304 replaces is canceled. computeETag returns a quoted value that is the same for the same body and differs for different bodies.
